Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Let The Wookiee Win (Revised)]] (September 1998). The Glossary Supplement of 29 January 2002 replaced this wording: [[Let The Wookiee Win (Decipher Errata 2002)]].
